name: omp-dev-team
description: Persona-driven AI development team for Oh-My-Pi — port of agentic-dev-team with local-model routing for the small tier.
comment: This repo is an OMP workspace: OMP auto-discovers .omp/{agents,skills,commands,extensions,rules}. There is intentionally no omp.extensions manifest here — native .omp/extensions discovery loads them, and listing them again would double-load. Install by running `omp` in this dir or copying .omp/ into your project (see README).
